name: Hazardous area electrical equipment
principle: Where flammable atmospheres can occur, electrical equipment is selected to exclude or contain ignition sources. Areas are classified by likelihood and duration (gas: Zone 0/1/2; dust: Zone 20/21/22) under IEC 60079-10 or DSEAR in the UK, then protected by equipment protection concepts matched to the zone: intrinsic safety (Ex ia/ib) for instrumentation, flameproof enclosures (Ex d), increased safety (Ex e), pressurisation (Ex p), encapsulation (Ex m) and others. The IECEx certification system covers equipment certification, conformity of installation and personnel competence across member countries.

process_steps.name: Hazardous area classification maps zones from leak sources and dispersion
Ex protection concept selected per zone and equipment group
Certified installation with correct glands, bonding and segregation
Initial and periodic inspections verify Ex integrity

performance.metric: LV equipment used in hazardous areas
performance.basis: hazardous-area equipment operates at the TNB LV level in process plants

limitations: modified or uncertified equipment voids the Ex certificate and the legal case for safe operation
zone extent depends on ventilation; offshore modules need module-level justification
advantages: internationally recognised certification chain lets equipment and crews move between projects
intrinsic safety removes ignition energy from instrument circuits entirely

sources.note: HSE guidance on explosive atmospheres and DSEAR duties, read 2026-11-07
TNB voltage and fault-level tables, read 2026-11-13
